declarations.description:
A form-associated amount field, the money input of the Stripe dashboard and Shopify admin. The value is an
**integer count of minor units** (`value="1050"` is $10.50, `value="1050" currency="JPY"` is ¥1,050), so amounts
never pass through floating point; `amount` reads and writes the same value in major units.

The field groups digits as the user types and shows the currency symbol on the side the locale puts it (`$12.50`,
`12,50 €`). It accepts the locale's decimal separator, and `.` or `,` wherever the locale does not use it for
grouping; a pasted `1,234.56` or `1.234,56` reads as 1234.56 whatever the locale. Typing stops at the currency's
minor-unit digits (2 for USD, 0 for JPY, 3 for KWD), and the fraction is padded when the field loses focus.
Amounts are positive unless `min` is negative. The locale is `locale`, else the nearest `lang`, else the browser's.

`currencies` lists the currencies the user may pick from: with two or more, a currency picker follows the amount.
Picking another currency keeps the amount in major units (10.50 USD becomes 10.50 EUR) and fires `currency-change`.

The value is submitted under `name`; with `currency-name`, the currency code is submitted too. `required`, `min`
and `max` (both in minor units) report `valueMissing`, `rangeUnderflow` and `rangeOverflow`.

slots.description: Replaces the currency symbol drawn next to the amount.
slots.name: symbol

slots.description: Replaces the chevron of the currency picker.
slots.name: chevron-icon

slots.description: Rich helper content below the field. `help` and `error-text` are plain-text shortcuts.
slots.name: supporting-text

members.name: field
members.description: Label and description handed down by an enclosing `c2-form-field`, which then draws the supporting line.

members.name: committedValue
members.description: The value when the field last committed (gained focus or fired `change`).

members.name: textValue
members.description: The minor units the text in the field stands for, so a value written back from typing leaves the text alone.

members.name: value
members.description: The amount as an integer count of minor units (`'1050'` for 10.50 USD), or an empty string.

members.name: currency
members.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency (`USD`, `EUR`, `JPY`). Decides the symbol and the minor-unit digits.

members.name: currencies
members.description: Currencies the user may pick from, as ISO codes. With two or more a picker is shown. As an attribute, separated by semicolons.

members.name: currencyDisplay
members.description: How the currency is written next to the amount: `symbol` (`CA$`), `narrowSymbol` (`$`) or `code` (`CAD`).

members.name: locale
members.description: BCP 47 locale for separators and the symbol position. Empty uses the nearest `lang`, then the browser's language.

members.name: min
members.description: Smallest valid value, in minor units. A negative `min` lets the user type a minus sign.

members.name: max
members.description: Largest valid value, in minor units.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name of the value.

members.name: currencyName
members.description: Form field name of the currency code. Empty submits the value only.

members.name: currencyLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the currency picker, when two fields with pickers sit together ("You send currency"). Default: "Currency".

members.name: autocomplete
members.description: Browser autocomplete hint, such as `transaction-amount`.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Text shown while the field is empty. Empty shows zero in the currency's format (`0.00`).

members.name: required
members.description: Requires an amount before the form can be submitted.

members.name: readOnly
members.description: Prevents editing while keeping the value in form submission.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Prevents interaction and excludes the value from form submission.

members.name: error
members.description: Applies the visual error state and sets `aria-invalid`.

members.name: help
members.description: Helper text shown below the field.

members.name: errorText
members.description: Message shown below the field while `error` is set.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name forwarded to the amount field.

members.name: fractionDigits
members.description: Digits after the decimal separator in the current currency: 2 for USD, 0 for JPY, 3 for KWD.

members.name: amount
members.description: The value in major units (`10.5` for `value="1050"` in USD), or `NaN` when empty. Setting it rounds to the minor unit.

members.name: select
members.description: Selects the amount text.

members.name: displayAmount
members.description: The value written as the currency formats it, for validation messages (`$5.00`).

members.name: commit
members.description: Pads the fraction and fires `change` when the value moved since the last commit.

events.name: change
events.description: The value was committed: the field lost focus or Enter was pressed after an edit, or a picked currency changed the value.

events.name: currency-change
events.description: The user picked another currency. Does not bubble; listen on the element.

events.name: input
events.description: Re-dispatched from the amount field on every edit; also fired when a picked currency changes the value.
